channels.contract:
# Legacy scalar migration fixture contract. The authored field order below is
# the legacy wire order at c8aa467; canonical v2 order sorts by name. `yaw` and
# `pitch` are equal-width float64 fields whose legacy and v2 offsets are swapped.
apiVersion: contracts.neuradix.io/v1alpha1
kind: StreamContract
metadata:
  namespace: io.neuradix.fixtures
  name: legacy-probe
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  description: Mixed-width scalar probe recorded by the pre-v2 codec
  payload:
    type: object
    fields:
      yaw:
        type: float64
        unit: rad
      pitch:
        type: float64
        unit: rad
      count:
        type: int32
      armed:
        type: bool
      rate:
        type: float32
        unit: Hz
      ticks:
        type: uint64
      offset:
        type: int64
      flags:
        type: uint32

  semantics:
    frame: vehicle/base
    clockDomain: monotonic
    authoritativeTimestamp: measurement
    maximumAge: 100ms

  delivery:
    capacity: 8
    overflow: keep-latest

# The standard vehicle-depth contract with its two float64 fields authored in
# reverse. Schema identity is order-independent, so it equals the standard
# contract's; the c8aa467 codec nevertheless wrote `uncertainty` first.
apiVersion: contracts.neuradix.io/v1alpha1
kind: StreamContract
metadata:
  namespace: io.neuradix.navigation
  name: vehicle-depth
  version: 1.0.0

spec:
  description: Vehicle depth below the configured water reference
  payload:
    type: object
    fields:
      uncertainty:
        type: float64
        unit: m
      depth:
        type: float64
        unit: m

  semantics:
    frame: vehicle/base
    clockDomain: monotonic
    authoritativeTimestamp: measurement
    maximumAge: 100ms

  delivery:
    capacity: 8
    overflow: keep-latest
